new_program_gaps.evidence: After an EA stage failure, the orchestrator still loads existing EA, metric and Terrain50 files and computes numeric_success from payload statuses rather than current stage exits or a generation token.
new_program_gaps.required: Quarantine prior outputs; bind every stage to one run_id and require current exit_code=0 plus matching run_id.

new_program_gaps.evidence: 014 _run invokes EA, metric, Terrain50 and web subprocesses without a timeout.
new_program_gaps.required: Apply per-stage wall-clock limits and persist timeout/termination receipts.

new_program_gaps.evidence: 014 _write writes directly to final JSON paths, so interruption can expose truncated documents.
new_program_gaps.required: Write, fsync and validate an attempt-scoped temporary file, then replace atomically.

new_program_gaps.evidence: Branch, page, task and attempt checks run only when environment values are non-empty; omitted values proceed.
new_program_gaps.required: Require all control identity values before any input/output access.

new_program_gaps.evidence: After a failed numeric stage, the entrypoint loads an existing final output and can copy stale row, coverage or web fields into a blocked summary.
new_program_gaps.required: Accept fields only from a current run_id and stage receipt; otherwise publish zero/unknown.

new_program_gaps.evidence: The timeout wrapper does not establish or terminate a Windows process group/job for descendant stages.
new_program_gaps.required: Use an explicit process group/job object and prove descendant cleanup after timeout.

new_program_gaps.evidence: An invalid configured base is swallowed and the verifier silently probes default loopback locations.
new_program_gaps.required: Reject an explicitly configured invalid base; fallback probing only when no explicit base is supplied.

new_program_gaps.evidence: Expected operation rows are parsed but not required to be positive and contract-bounded; zero or negative values weaken the floor.
new_program_gaps.required: Require a pinned positive bounded value, currently at least 1036.

new_program_gaps.evidence: Catalogue HTML is read without a byte bound or final-host, media-type and publication-identity validation.
new_program_gaps.required: Require approved HTTPS host, bounded HTML, expected media type, current publication and response SHA.

new_program_gaps.evidence: Authority downloads stream directly to their final ZIP path; interruption can leave a partial file in the reusable workspace.
new_program_gaps.required: Stream to attempt-scoped .part, validate ZIP/type/hash, replace atomically and remove partials on failure.

coordinated_updates_required: 014: run_id-bound clean outputs, stage exits, timeouts and atomic writes
entrypoint: mandatory identity, current-generation receipts and descendant cleanup
043 HMLR: bounded typed catalogue and atomic downloads
017 web: fail-closed explicit base and pinned row floor
why_not: No exact_write_paths authorise coordinated pinned runtime/control replacements; partial patch would invalidate revision16 verification.
